name: Drawer
description: A panel that slides in from an edge for filters, details or secondary tasks. Built on the dialog machine: a modal drawer traps focus, locks scroll and hides the page behind it from assistive technology; Escape, the close button and the backdrop close it, and focus returns to the trigger. The side follows the reading direction. The bottom side is the spec's sheet.

livewire.name: drawer
capabilities: wire:model binds open both ways through $wire.entangle()

props.name: open
props.description: Whether it's open. Livewire binds it with wire:model, Vue with v-model:open. Emitted as data-state on every part.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: The initial state of an uncontrolled drawer.

props.name: side
props.description: The edge it slides in from. end is on the right in LTR and on the left in RTL; bottom is a full-width sheet with a handle. Emitted as data-side on the panel and the positioner.

props.name: size
props.description: The panel's width at the start or end side: 320px, --apui-drawer-width (400px) or 560px, never wider than the viewport. A bottom sheet is full width. Emitted as data-size.

props.name: surface
props.description: The panel's surface. Emitted as data-surface. Glass falls back to the overlay surface under reduced transparency and in high contrast.

props.name: title
props.description: The heading, linked to the panel with aria-labelledby.
props.a11y: Every drawer needs a title; it is the panel's accessible name.

props.name: description
props.description: Supporting text under the title, linked with aria-describedby.

props.name: footer
props.description: The actions row. Put the primary action here.

props.name: trigger
props.description: Content for a trigger button that opens the drawer. Without it, open the drawer through open.

props.name: modal
props.description: Traps focus, locks scroll and hides the rest of the page from assistive technology. Turn it off for a drawer that leaves the page usable.

props.name: portal
props.description: Renders the drawer at the end of the body, above everything (x-teleport, a React portal, Vue Teleport). Off renders it in place.

props.name: hideClose
props.description: Hides the close button in the header. Escape still closes the drawer.

props.name: closeLabel
props.description: The close button's accessible name. Translate it: Livewire defaults it through __( 'Close' ).
props.a11y: The close button is icon-only, so this is its only name.

props.name: classes
props.description: Extra classes per part, such as { header: '…', body: '…' }.

parts.name: root
parts.description: The panel, carrying the root class. It is the dialog machine's content part, so it also carries data-part="content" (D-019).

parts.name: content
parts.description: The panel: the same element as root.

parts.name: trigger
parts.description: The button that opens the drawer, when trigger is set.

parts.name: positioner
parts.description: Fills the viewport and holds the panel against its side.

parts.name: handle
parts.description: The bottom sheet's grab handle. Decorative.

parts.name: closeTrigger
parts.description: The close button: a ghost, neutral, small icon-only Button.

parts.name: body
parts.description: The default slot. Scrolls when it's taller than the panel.

slots.name: title
slots.description: Rich title content, rendered inside the heading.

events.name: open-change
events.description: The drawer opened or closed itself: the trigger, Escape, the backdrop or the close button. Setting open doesn't fire it.

keyboard.action: Move between the controls inside; focus stays in a modal drawer.
Closes the drawer and returns focus to the trigger.
On the trigger, opens the drawer.

requirements: Focus moves into the drawer on open and is trapped there while it's modal; it returns to the trigger on close.
The title is linked with aria-labelledby and the description with aria-describedby.
A modal drawer sets aria-modal, hides everything else from assistive technology and locks page scroll.
The side follows the reading direction: end is on the right in LTR and on the left in RTL, and the slide-in comes from that edge.
The close button has an accessible name (translatable, "Close").
Text keeps 4.5:1 and the panel's edge 3:1 on the overlay surface in every theme, glass included.
The slide-in animation is off under prefers-reduced-motion.
Every part keeps a stable, server-rendered id in Livewire, so morphs never replace the panel (D-015).
Don't open a drawer from a drawer.
